# Reorient

> Your Digital Nomad Gateway Into Asia

Reorient is a curated platform showcasing digital nomad events, workations, and coliving experiences across Asia for digital nomads, remote workers, and entrepreneurs.

## Events

Discover digital nomad events and workations across Asian countries including Japan, South Korea, Thailand, Vietnam, China, Malaysia, Taiwan, and the Philippines. Events range from week-long workations to month-long coliving experiences in cities, beaches, mountains, and rural locations.

- [Browse all events](https://reorient.guide/)
- [Individual events](https://reorient.guide/sitemap.xml): Complete list in sitemap

## Guides

Practical arrival and visa guides for digital nomads with visa information, connectivity, transportation, workspaces, and local tips.

- [Guides](https://reorient.guide/guides): Browse all guides
- [South Korea Arrival Guide](https://reorient.guide/guides/south-korea-for-digital-nomads): Complete practical guide
- [South Korea Visa Guide](https://reorient.guide/guides/south-korea-digital-nomad-startup-visa): Complete visa guide

## Site Structure

- `/` - Homepage with interactive map and all events
- `/events` - All nomad events
- `/events/{country}` - Events filtered by country
- `/events/{country}/{event-slug}` - Individual event details
- `/guides` - Guides index
- `/guides/{guide-slug}` - Individual guide
- `/sitemap.xml` - Complete URL list
